# Uni Parent

> Uni Parent is a deterministic, browser-only daily planning tool for university students.

## Primary pages

- [Daily planner](https://uni-parent.vercel.app/): Generate a balanced agenda around fixed commitments.
- [Profile](https://uni-parent.vercel.app/profile.html): Configure major, career direction, focus time, and editable wellbeing defaults.
- [Schedule](https://uni-parent.vercel.app/schedule.html): Add repeating class, work, and responsibility blocks.
- [Method and sources](https://uni-parent.vercel.app/sources.html): Read the planner logic, boundaries, privacy model, and limitations.

## Important facts

- The planner is deterministic and does not call an AI service.
- Student data remains in the current browser's localStorage.
- Age never removes career choices or predicts ability.
- Recommendations are planning suggestions, not medical, academic, or professional guarantees.
